sections.heading: 1. Set-up checklist
lines: ① A pillow under baby, to chest height.
② A small cushion behind your lower back.
③ Feet flat, or on a low stool.
④ After the feed, shoulder rolls × 10.

caption:
Feed after feed, day and night. After the 3am feed, Lulu's neck, upper back and lower back feel sore.

Leaning down towards baby means the neck and back hold that position for a long time. Raising baby on a pillow to chest height, and supporting your back and feet, can often feel much easier.

Hybi's set-up: pillow under baby, a small cushion behind your lower back, feet on a low stool, then 10 shoulder rolls after each feed.

Arm or hand tingling, pain waking you at night, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
